chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Ṣafwān, from al-ʿAlāʾ, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two عليهما السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who shook hands with a Magian. He said: "He should wash his hand and not perform wudu (ablution)."

key_terms.صَافَحَ: shook hands; made direct hand contact
key_terms.مَجُوسِيًّا: a Magian; a member of the Zoroastrian community

ai.seo_question: Does shaking hands with a Magian require wudu (ablution) or only washing the hand?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding contact with a Magian. It states that the hand should be washed after such contact, but that this does not require wudu (ablution), distinguishing between washing for impurity and wudu (ablution) as an act of ritual preparation.
